Rooms have balconies or terraces for enjoying scenic views, with fresh air and a peaceful atmosphere. Surroundings include mountains, streams, and a tranquil rural setting.
Hosts are warm, hospitable, and provide attentive service, such as helping with travel arrangements, offering fruits, and preparing abundant breakfasts.
Rooms and facilities are clean and tidy, meeting high standards of sanitation.
Features wooden-style rooms with comfortable layouts, some having balconies or terraces, and a cozy environment
